about: Vectors for the operator's mandate, mandate/1 (DEC-0125, MD-1 to MD-6), written by tools/vectors/mandate.ts, never by hand. mandateCovers({mandate, tier, now, self, callerAgent?, call: {capability, action?, effect, spendUsd?, project?}}) answers {ignored: mandate-at-t2} for a T2 caller (its mandate changes nothing); {ok: false, code: decision-invalid, data: {detail}} for a document that is not the schema's, stands more than 7 days, or whose chain goes back in time, repeats an agent or exceeds four (mandate-malformed), a hand-over that widens a list, the effects or the per-call ceiling or drops one (mandate-widened), a chain that does not end in self, or, when the callee authenticated its caller's agent id (callerAgent), does not name it before self (mandate-not-for-this-call), one given more than 60 s after the clock (mandate-early) or past its expiry (mandate-expired); {ok: false, code: operator-decision-required, data: {detail: outside-mandate: <action|capability|effect|spend|project>, estimateUsd?, perCallMaxUsd?}} for a valid one that does not cover the call, naming the first part not covered in that order; otherwise {ok: true, recordAs: {by: operator, via: mandate, task, chain, source?}}, source being where the operator said the words when the mandate carries it (DEC-0126 OA-6). The scope in force is the last chain entry's that names one, else the mandate's. A relayed action is covered when the scope's actions list it, or, with no actions listed, its capabilities include its tool; change-policy is never covered (AP-5); an effect beyond draft needs the call named, a relayed action by actions or capabilities and any other call by capabilities; with perCallMaxUsd the call's own estimate must exist and be within it, without it the money limits decide. {fault} is the callee's own and never sent. `handOn`: handOn({mandate, callee, at, narrower?}) answers {mandate} the agent sends with its call, the chain gaining {agent: callee, at, scope: narrower?} (MD-2), or the problem FAC-SEM-144 finds in the resulting document: {refused: mandate-widened} for a narrower scope that asks for more than the scope in force (an entry of a list the scope in force does not hold, a list it holds that is dropped, an effect outside its ceiling's closure as a grant's, a higher or dropped per-call ceiling; adding a list the scope in force has none of narrows it), or {refused: mandate-malformed} for a result that is not the schema's, a step back in time (an equal time is in order) or at or after expiresAt, an agent already in the chain or a fifth; source travels unchanged.
